name: sasq64/chipmachine
description: A demoscene and retro music jukebox player supporting over 40 formats including MOD, XM, IT, NSF, SPC, SID, and Game Boy, with incremental search across large music collections.

summary: Multi-format retro music player with 40+ supported formats
